rules.head_form: alphabetic, capitalised, lowercase after the first letter
rules.inventory: every word (letters only, case-insensitive) of: FICTION (24), FRAME_SUBJECTS (6), every country and capital of both g6 screens, coined_head (24), coined_mod (24), CANON/PTEST/described-as/is-a/associated-with templates, GENERIC (20), UNRELATED (10), the LAW#5 strings
rules.relations_forbidden: equality; head a prefix of a word; head a substring of a word (every inventory word); a word a prefix of the head; a word a substring of the head (names of any length, common words of >= 4 letters)
rules.bpe: tok(' ' + head) has >= 2 pieces in the base tokenizer
rules.registration: after register(heads + coined_mod): tok(' ' + w) == [id] for all 48; tok(' ' + head + ' ' + mod) == [id_head, id_mod] and CANON + value == CANON ids + the pair for all 24; P2a pre-screen identical over the deduplicated inventory prompts; every bigram-control prompt CANON(subject) + head == CANON ids + [id_head] over the 24 edited and 6 never-edited subjects (these prompts contain the minted head by design and are excluded from P2a); arm B: every frozen value == the head's base pieces + [id_mod]
rules.pairing: value i = heads[i] + ' ' + coined_mod[i] for FICTION[i] (injective; every head identifies its modifier)
rules.selection: passing candidates in authored order until the head piece-count multiset equals the frozen A7 heads' (head_pieces_quota)
